_comment: Expected Stage 5.2 benign results for SCRIPTED Blue, keyed by benign_id (request_id is random per run). Predicted BY HAND from blue/signatures.py BEFORE the first live run (2026-11-09), not observed. If a live result differs, stage5_2_check.py FAILS and every mismatch goes to the designer BEFORE this file changes (designer rule). Prediction: scripted Blue flags none of the 17, so FP rate 0/17. That is a measurement of scripted Blue, not a goal: neither the set nor the signatures are tuned to it. Expected anomalies: none (h06's Error Handling solve is in its expected_solves).

n01.why: no quote, no SQL/XSS/traversal token in the JSON body

n03.why: 'horse'/'correct' contain 'or' only inside words, so \b(or|and)\s+\d+ cannot match

n07.why: /ftp/legal.md has no NUL byte, so the .md suffix pattern needs \x00 and does not fire

n10.why: registration body: email + matching passwords, no tokens

n11.why: plain login of the n10 user

h01.why: 'union' without 'select' (union\s+select needs both; '+' stays '+' after percent-decoding)

h04.why: the quote in Don't is followed by 't', so no quote-then-or/and/--/=/; pattern fires

h06.why: the quote in o'brien is followed by 'b', so no quote pattern fires
